import ast
import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import textwrap
from types import SimpleNamespace
import torch

eta = Path('/home/sky/RL/EtaZero-lab/EtaZero_V3')
source = Path('/home/sky/RL/SkyZero-lab/KataGo')
sys.path.insert(0, str(eta / 'python'))
from etazero.katago_network import KataGoNet
from etazero.symmetry import augment_batch
from etazero.games import SPECS

def source_function(path, name):
    tree = ast.parse(path.read_text())
    return next(node for node in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name == name)

class Receiver:
    def set_brenorm_params(self, momentum, rmax, dmax):
        self.bounds = [rmax, dmax]

ref, local = Receiver(), Receiver()
state = {'global_step_samples': 0}
options = {'avg_momentum': 0.001, 'target_rmax': 3.0, 'target_dmax': 5.0, 'adjustment_scale': 1000000.0}
node = source_function(source / 'python/train.py', 'maybe_update_brenorm_params')
factory = 'def make_update():\n    last_brenorm_update_samples_this_instance = 0\n' + textwrap.indent(ast.unparse(node), '    ') + '\n    return maybe_update_brenorm_params\n'
namespace = {'math': math, 'train_state': state, 'model_config': {'norm_kind': 'brenorm'},
             'raw_model': ref, 'brenorm_adjustment_scale': options['adjustment_scale'],
             'brenorm_target_rmax': options['target_rmax'], 'brenorm_target_dmax': options['target_dmax'],
             'brenorm_avg_momentum': options['avg_momentum']}
exec(factory, namespace)
update = namespace['make_update']()
update()
renorm = []
for samples in (0, 128, 499*128, 500*128):
    state['global_step_samples'] = samples
    if samples == 500*128:
        update()
    KataGoNet.prepare_brenorm(SimpleNamespace(norm_kind='brenorm', network=local), samples, options)
    renorm.append({'consumed_samples': samples, 'source_bounds': ref.bounds[:], 'eta_bounds': local.bounds[:]})
assert renorm[1]['source_bounds'] != renorm[1]['eta_bounds']

path = source / 'python/katago/train/data_processing_pytorch.py'
namespace = {'torch': torch, 'modelconfigs': SimpleNamespace(ModelConfig=dict,
    get_num_bin_input_features=lambda _: 22, get_num_global_input_features=lambda _: 19)}
for name in ('build_history_matrices', 'apply_history_matrices'):
    exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[source_function(path, name)], type_ignores=[]), str(path), 'exec'), namespace)
n = 10000
obs = torch.ones(n, 22, 3, 3)
glob = torch.ones(n, 19)
targets = torch.ones(n, 41)
base, builder = namespace['build_history_matrices']({}, 'cpu')
torch.manual_seed(853)
out, gout = namespace['apply_history_matrices']({}, obs, glob, targets, base, builder)
local_batch = augment_batch({'obs': obs, 'globals': glob}, 0, SPECS['go'])
history = {'samples': n, 'seed': 853,
    'source_rows_with_masked_history': int((gout[:, :5] == 0).any(1).sum()),
    'eta_rows_with_masked_history': int((local_batch['globals'][:, :5] == 0).any(1).sum()),
    'source_masked_counts_by_lag': (gout[:, :5] == 0).sum(0).tolist(),
    'expected_probability_any': 1 - 0.98**5}
assert history['source_rows_with_masked_history'] > 0 and history['eta_rows_with_masked_history'] == 0

record = json.loads((eta/'reference_sources.json').read_text())['KataGo']
matches = {name: hashlib.sha256((source/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == sha for name, sha in record['sha256'].items()}
assert all(matches.values())
result = {'method': 'Exact source AST functions; production Eta methods. CPU synthetic tensors, no training run.',
          'source_commit': subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(source),'rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),
          'source_manifest_files': len(matches), 'source_hashes_all_match': all(matches.values()),
          'brenorm': renorm, 'history_dropout': history}
Path(__file__).with_name('reproductions.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2)+'\n')
